# Anna Bedia — Software Engineer

> Portfolio of Anna Bedia, a Software Engineer working across software engineering, systems, product and UX.

## About

Anna Bedia is a Software Engineer with a background in digital design, digital illustration, animation and creative technology.

Her work combines software engineering with product and UX thinking, with a growing focus on backend systems, architecture, cloud infrastructure and the technologies underneath the interface.

## Selected Work

### Android Developer Documentation

Project for Google. Developer documentation platform work for developer.android.com.

Anna works across reusable documentation components, homepage merchandising, content tooling and cloud-to-monorepo publishing workflows.

Technologies include Astro, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Web Components, Node.js, Strapi, GCP, Cloud Run, YAML, Sass and npm.

Project website: https://developer.android.com/

### Internal Project Tracking Tool

Project for Google. Enterprise platform work involving project management, data-driven workflows and operational visibility.

Anna contributed across frontend development, application behaviour, state management and backend-integrated workflows.

Technologies include Vue.js, Vuex, Vuetify, Django, Python, MySQL and Cypress.

### Google Ads Rewards

Project for Google. Customer-facing product work focused on responsive, accessible and reusable interfaces.

Anna contributed to frontend development within a Django and Python application and an enterprise CMS.

Project website: https://adsrewards.withgoogle.com/

Technologies include Django, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, accessibility, responsive design, UI components and Playwright.

### NC News

Independent full-stack software engineering project.

A news application built with React, Node.js, Express.js and PostgreSQL. The application supports article browsing, topic filtering, voting, commenting and user interactions.

Technologies include React, React Router, Context API, Axios, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQL, Jest and Supertest.

## Other Projects
